evidence.detail: rs/runelite/a/c is a nine-value enum with surviving exact constants UNKNOWN, STARTING, LOGIN_SCREEN, LOGIN_SCREEN_AUTHENTICATOR, LOGGING_IN, LOADING, LOGGED_IN, CONNECTION_LOST and HOPPING.
The enum preserves exact numeric state ids -1, 0, 10, 11, 20, 25, 30, 40 and 45 and exposes deterministic int-to-enum and enum-to-int conversion.
rs/runelite/events/GameStateChanged stores this exact type in a field literally named gameState and exposes exact getGameState()/setGameState(...) methods.
Client constructs and posts GameStateChanged events with these enum values during real client transitions including LOADING, LOGIN_SCREEN and LOGGING_IN.
The type is referenced by Client plus login, plugin/sidebar and Trading Post runtime classes, matching a shared top-level client game-state contract rather than a feature-local enum.

candidates.note: GameState is fixed by exact enum state names/ids and the surviving GameStateChanged.gameState/getGameState/setGameState API. Confidence is 0.999.
